assertions.source: TL₃-computed V(5₂) == known q⁻¹−q⁻²+2q⁻³−q⁻⁴+q⁻⁵−q⁻⁶ (or its mirror) — validates the H₃/TL₃ machinery

assertions.name: jones_4one_bar_even_5two_bar_odd
assertions.source: V(4₁) bar-odd = 0 (amphichiral), V(5₂) bar-odd ≠ 0 (chiral) — the complete classical bar-odd datum

description: Full 5₂ Jones via a self-contained Temperley–Lieb Kauffman bracket (TL₃ diagram algebra), validated against known V(4₁), V(5₂). Extracts the complete classical bar-odd datum: V(4₁) bar-odd = 0 (amphichiral), V(5₂) bar-odd ≠ 0 (chiral). Step 2 of the non-amphichiral route — validates the machinery before the quantum-volume step. The classical Jones bar-odd datum is O(1) at q₀, ~1e8× above N_odd=S·u³ and anchor-smooth, so NOT the swing (no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing binds); it is the complete bar-odd HOME, the swing needs 𝔙_q(5₂). No c_k; no fit; scope-(a).

data.scale_contrast: classical Jones bar-odd V(5₂)_odd(q₀) is O(1), ~1e8× above N_odd=S·u³ (O(1e-8)) and anchor-smooth ⇒ not the S-swing (no_anchor_invariant_realizes_swing). The writhe datum sinh(u) is the leading term of this full bar-odd datum.
data.verdict: 5₂ FULL JONES BAR-ODD DATUM validated + extracted. The self-contained TL₃ Kauffman bracket reproduces known V(4₁) (palindromic, bar-odd 0) and V(5₂) (non-palindromic, bar-odd ≠ 0) — the H₃/TL₃ machinery is trusted. The complete classical bar-odd datum V(5₂)_odd is O(1) at q₀ and anchor-smooth, so it is the bar-odd HOME but not the swing (the prune binds); the writhe sinh(u) is its leading term. Step 1 (quantum 𝔙_q(5₂), anchor-dependent) is the swing test. No c_k; no fit; scope-(a).
